image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject features a distinct oval shape with a reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping, striped calcareous plates. The background consists of textured rock with patches of purple coralline algae.
